startup: KeepEXT_PERMITopen andmotor12V disconnected for firstlogic/ESC tests.
InitializeGPIOODR low beforeoutput; CSremainHiZ untilVIOvalid; TIM4disabled/CCR0.
Readpots andtemperature; invalid, open, out-of-range or unknownposition prohibitsmotion.
ValidatecorrectSII/PDI, EEPROMchecksum, stackstate and watchdog; demonstrate loss-of-link handling withmotorsdisconnected.
Sampledsoftwarefault, watchdogexpiry orpermitloss clearsARM andSLEEPrequests; definecoast/brake/hold by measuredapplicationrisk, notby nSLEEP name.

AnyESCresetfall latchessoftwareinhibit; neverautomaticallyresume whenESCreset rises. MCUresetreturnsallARM/SLEEP requeststolow; bootrequiresnewvalidatedsession. Actualresetsequencingmustbeoscilloscopeverified.
